toegepas.voor: uit riviere en damme en party pomp
toegepas.na: uit riviere en damme, en party pomp
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two clauses with their own subject and verb (Boere kry / party pomp), so a comma is required; it also stops 'damme en party' reading as one list.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS 2017 comma: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb (Boere kry / party pomp).
toegepas.rede_keurder: The second clause has its own subject and verb, so AWS 2017 requires the comma, and it stops 'damme en party' from reading as one list; no protected wording is touched.

laat_vaar.voor: 'n Mieliekop kan byvoorbeeld staan vir 'n gebied met baie mielielande.
laat_vaar.na: 'n Mieliekop kan byvoorbeeld 'n gebied met baie mielielande aandui.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'staan vir' is a calque of English 'stand for'; 'aandui' is the natural Afrikaans verb for what a map symbol does.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Staan vir' is accepted, plain Afrikaans for what a symbol represents and is easy for Grade 4; 'aandui' is more formal and shifts 'represents' toward 'indicates', so this is a lateral move.
